paper: Where Detectors Fail: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (PROBE, ICML 2026, arXiv 2605.24906)
training_set_in_paper: PROBE-ResNet50 (ResNet-50 trained on GenImage SD v1.4 + PROBE samples). Only the released checkpoint (ResNet50_best_model_step_19343.pth, ModelScope shuinishaojiu/PROBE-AIGI-Detection) is evaluated here; the generator-probing and fine-tuning code is not released, so there is no SynthScope-trained checkpoint. Metric: balanced accuracy at 0.5 (positive = fake), mean over the paper's subsets (Table 1 Avg = mean of Tables 2-4); SynthScope's means.acc is the same quantity. Inference: official protocol (pad to the crop size, ImageNet normalisation, mean logit of non-overlapping 224 patches), exact parity with the official evaluate_resnet.py. The paper's 7-benchmark Avg (78.1) is not comparable with our 5-benchmark mean because Chameleon and AIGI-Quality-Paradox were not run.
